title: BestConfigDeploy
description: Deploy publish-result and finalize contracts of the agent-configuration-head deploy target (TRAIG-101 plan 8.7). Closed: refs, digests, enums, integers and timestamps only. The published CONFIGURATION itself is customer content (plan 8.4), is NOT part of this closed contract and is not covered by the Director bridge guarantee; it is classified in best_config_agent_head_config_schema.json.

DeployIdempotencyKey.description: Deploy idempotency key `deploy:{attempt_ref}:{candidate_fingerprint}:{gate_result_digest}`, carried on the publish in header X-Traigent-Deploy-Idempotency-Key and stored with a durable publish-result record. Fixed shape of refs and digests only. Same key replays the original result before any stale-generation check.

state.description: succeeded: the publish committed and advanced the head; cancelled: a cancellation tombstone was committed under the head lock (a tombstoned publication cannot commit); pending: neither yet.

head_generation.description: Head generation produced by the committed publish; null unless succeeded.

pinned_version.description: Pinned config version promoted; null unless succeeded.

DeployPublishResult.description: Durable publish-result record of a deploy. An absent lookup alone never justifies a terminal outcome; unavailable or timed-out finalization means HOLD.

DeployFinalizeRequest.description: Finalize a deploy publish: under the agent-head lock only (never the best-config row), return the stored success or commit a cancellation tombstone. Body carries only the version; the key is the path.
